remarks: Tucked away on a sought-after Westport cul-de-sac, this elegant 5-bedroom home offers the perfect blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Set on over an acre of beautifully landscaped property, enjoy resort-style living with a stunning gunite pool, private patio, and lush lawn-ideal for summer entertaining or peaceful relaxation. The spacious first-floor primary suite is a true retreat, complete with his and her separate bathrooms and a private sauna. The heart of the home is the chef's kitchen featuring a Wolfe cooktop, Sub-Zero refrigerator, and generous workspace, opening to a sun drenched eating areas. With two dedicated offices, working from home is effortless. Located just minutes from schools, shopping, beaches, and transportation, this centrally located gem offers the best of Westport living-privacy, space, and style-all in one of town's most desirable neighborhoods. A rare find that checks every box!
